Himeros is a 5-star Legendary Ice hero from the

While he might look like a cherub who got lost on the way to a diaper commercial, don't let the wings fool you. This Rogue plays dirty. He’s designed to strip your defenses before slapping you in the face, all while cheering on his teammates to hit harder. He fits the archetype of a

The artwork features a dynamic, winged character clad in dark blue and black leather armor adorned with hearts. It’s a bit of an "emo cupid" vibe—less "love and light," more "I will steal your buffs and your girl."

There was a bit of a community debate on release regarding Himeros's gender, given the mythological Himeros is the god of sexual desire (and male), while the in-game art has a somewhat androgynous, perhaps feminine, appearance. Let's just say Himeros is here to break hearts, regardless of pronouns.
